boundary: Prospective source-review contract only. No analyzer capability, actual SDK/header qualification, dataset admission or product PASS is asserted.
reference_boundary: Documentation was consulted for semantic design, not copied as an SDK inventory. GNU 2.42 and Microsoft Learn references do not establish the actual native runner or SDK version. Exact three-platform header/ABI identities remain required before freeze.

required_evidence: complete target-resolved signature and variadic arity
actual defining header path and content digest
included header closure and compilation-command identity
no conflicting user implementation or unsupported interposition
declaration_identity.alias_boundary: C++ namespace imports and macro/fortify redirections require canonical-declaration/header linkage; textual names and fake matching prototypes do not establish library semantics.
declaration_identity.entry_boundary: The argv intrinsic requires the actual declared program entry and parameter identity. It is not a native library call and does not require main to originate in a library header.

required_behaviors: category-specific validation on the checked branch and value
flow.identity: Every origin and validation fact binds a value/object version, call context, declaration and body where applicable.
flow.overwrite_boundary: A complete proven text overwrite may kill prior content origins. Partial writes retain unaffected origins; zero-length writes do not create transferred content. Unsupported ranges or uncertain termination stay unknown, not clean.
flow.formatting_boundary: Constant-format data interpolation can propagate untrusted text into an output buffer without making that format argument untrusted. Consumed arguments, limits, termination and output mutation need actual modeling; a function name or nonliteral operand is insufficient.
flow.helper_boundary: Only direct, nonrecursive same-TU bodies with exact declaration/body identities. Preserve caller/callee source locations, parameter/return/output/sink relations and aliases.
trace_required: propagation locations and consumed byte/value relation
caller and callee locations for summaries
validation context or explicit unsupported reason
flow.output_boundary: Unknown relevant flow cannot acquire a safe label or disappear from an already frozen denominator; incomplete analysis is not a zero-finding PASS.

sources.success: A declared program entry and an in-range non-null argument element; an arbitrary function/parameter name is not an entry source.
sources.extent: The selected argument's string content; no implicit external-caller parameter taint.
sources.failure: Out-of-range/null/unknown entry context is not a fabricated string origin.

sources.success: Non-null result supplies environment content, not the name argument.
sources.extent: Returned string; subsequent mutation/lifetime follows the selected native model.
sources.failure: Null result contributes no string; secure_getenv is not a universal category sanitizer.

sources.success: Successful input with a valid writable extent and count at least two.
sources.extent: Received characters and the established terminator; distinguish capacity from actual content.
sources.failure: EOF/error and small-count cases require their actual native behavior; failure cannot manufacture initialized or clean content.

sources.success: Read item count and item size establish the completed region; zero size/count is distinct.
sources.extent: Completed items are not bytes unless item size is one. Partial items, text translation and content past the returned region remain separately unknown.
sources.failure: Zero completed items can coexist with a partial item; return zero is not a general unchanged-buffer proof.

sources.success: A positive byte-count result on valid input.
sources.extent: Only actual written bytes are established; no implicit NUL termination.
sources.failure: EOF, errors and unknown mutation are distinguished from fresh content and do not create validation.

sources.success: A positive returned count on a valid descriptor/buffer.
sources.extent: Counted bytes under the captured native text/binary mode; no implicit NUL termination.
sources.failure: EOF/error is not positive source evidence or a generic buffer reset.

sources.success: Valid socket input, with flags and return semantics explicitly covered by the selected native model.
sources.extent: Actual buffer region, not blindly the requested length or a message-size return; no implicit NUL termination.
sources.failure: Unmodeled flags/partial/error behavior is visible unknown and must be resolved before a case is admitted.

sources.success: Valid initialized Winsock socket and covered flags/result behavior.
sources.extent: Actual received buffer bytes; no implicit NUL termination.
sources.failure: WSAEMSGSIZE can accompany buffer writes, so a SOCKET_ERROR result alone does not establish no mutation.

format-string.condition: Proven untrusted content must reach the format argument. Trusted/nonliteral format and untrusted data under a fixed format are different roles.
safe_controls: fixed format with untrusted data argument
wrong argument not treated as format
format-string.unmodeled: Unlisted va_list, wide-character, locale-specific and other variants do not inherit support by family name.

command-injection.condition: Proven untrusted command-string content reaches a modeled shell interpreter context; mode and other arguments are separate.
command-injection.platform_boundary: POSIX shell and Windows command-processor semantics are not interchangeable. No quoting sanitizer is accepted by name or globally across shells.
safe_controls: fixed executable with separate argv and no shell interpretation
command-injection.unmodeled: User-chosen executable, tool option injection, unlisted launch APIs and shell wrappers require separate explicit threat/model evidence.

sql-injection.condition: Track proven untrusted SQL-text content into sqlite3_exec/prepare_v2/prepare_v3. Preparing already-constructed text does not separate its data from syntax.
safe_controls: trusted query text with parameter values supplied by bind
untrusted bind value does not become query syntax
prepare flags do not cleanse query text
sql-injection.boundary: A bind call changes a selected statement parameter, not the original input string or SQL text. Exact statement, parameter, types/lifetime and success remain required; this is not all-rule safety or support for other DB/ORM/UTF-16 APIs.

path-traversal.condition: A frozen trusted restricted-root policy must bind the path value/version and filesystem sink. A variable name, concatenated root-looking prefix or ordinary user filename is not that policy.
safe_controls: correct checked component containment for the declared platform/root
trusted path under the explicit policy
no invented root policy for ordinary file access

selection_gaps: named copy/concatenation/formatting APIs and exact C++ overload selection
complete source-attributed evaluation and security-fix pairs
concrete per-case restricted-root contracts and native semantics
no_hidden_scope_extension: The documented table is a draft selection within the approved CH08/CH11 outcome; it cannot admit cases, classify a later miss as unsupported, reduce the frozen denominator, or amend BOOK. Final freeze still requires every U003 acceptance item.
